actual_scope: Kappa-blocker KB3f (set level, no words): press the vanishing-character restriction of PR 2911 against the four surviving splits of the 18-point cover question for F2^7. Delivered outcome=partial: an exact classification of the vanishing configurations and a per-class verdict. (1) L2 PROVEN: a vanishing character forces the vanishing side to split equally across its kernel, so at (11,7)/(9,9) both sides odd NO character can vanish and the restriction is vacuous exactly on those two splits. (2) L3 PROVEN (exhaustive m=3, 256x256 pairs): the exact half-decomposition of both covering lines across ker(psi). (3) L4 (class floors): exact union-size bounds on the half lines (in character language they re-derive PR 2911's even-half and odd-half bounds); the forced-split consequences PROVE six vanishing classes impossible: (12,6) D-vanish (12,0),(11,1),(10,2) and (10,8) A-vanish (8,0), D-vanish (10,0),(9,1). (4) L5 PROVEN (exhaustive m=3): two simultaneous vanishings force the balanced grid (x,y,y,x). (5) L7 PROVEN (exhaustive m=3): floor equality plus coverage forces Sidon cross sums (|A0+A1| = a0*a1, |D0+D1| = d0*d1, disjoint, union the whole odd half), pinning the two tight classes (10,8) A-vanish (7,1) and D-vanish (8,2) and the full-sumset class (12,6) A-vanish (6,0) to exact forced structure. (6) Ground-truth census: all covers of F2^4 (41,341 of 65,536 subsets) and of F2^5 (all C(32,10) = 64,512,240 ten-sets, 317,440 covers of which 99,200 through {0} reproducing PR 2773's n5 control exactly) classified by split and vanishing type: F2^5 ten-covers exist only in splits (2,8)/(4,6)/(6,4)/(8,2), every cover has vanishing characters, and no cover hits a dead class (soundness of the floors on 358,781 real covers). (7) Bounded class-restricted seeded search over all 16 surviving classes (30 restarts each) finds no 18-point cover (best 115..119 of 128) while the identical machinery instantly finds F2^5 covers free and in-class (non-vacuity). No split excluded outright; the gap 20 <= f(7) <= 24 is unchanged.
